metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for CI/CD, Rust, documentation, code analysis, design, Solana indexing, multi-agent orchestration, meta-tooling, and truth-verification.

plugins.name: ci-moonrepo
plugins.description: moonrepo v2.2 (v2.2.4) expert -- workspace setup, task orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (with a comprehensive moon-ci guide weaving production failure modes into prescriptive patterns), Docker integration, remote caching, code generation, WASM plugin toolchains, MQL queries, v1-to-v2 migration, and a curated catalogue of real-world gotchas from production monorepos. Five reactive hooks (SessionStart workspace-orientation, PreToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit moon-config guard, PreToolUse Bash moon-ci guard, UserPromptSubmit topic tagger) bring the skill to the agent at edit-time and command-time, with hard denies on .moon/tasks.yml (singular) and on moon-ci invocations referencing github.event.before. Standalone scripts/lint-moon-config.sh for CI use.

plugins.name: rust-utoipa
plugins.description: Rust OpenAPI documentation with utoipa v5.4. Complete macro reference, path attributes, security schemes, enum handling, validation, and integrations for Axum, Actix-web, Rocket.

plugins.name: docs-eventcatalog
plugins.description: Document event-driven architectures with EventCatalog. Covers all 13 resource types (including Data Products), the full SDK (snapshots, DSL builders, custom docs), 15+ generator integrations, MCP server, visualizations, and schema support.

plugins.name: rust-fmodel
plugins.description: Functional domain modeling in Rust with fmodel-rust v0.9 (MSRV 1.75+, native async-fn-in-trait). Decider, View, Saga domain types, algebraic composition via combine/merge/map, and application-layer wiring (aggregates, MaterializedView, SagaManager).

plugins.name: analysis-codebase-archaeology
plugins.description: Deep structural analysis of any codebase -- extracts business rules, maps data flows, traces dependencies, assesses risk, and produces transformation plans. 7 analysis lenses, 2 specialized subagents, 1 slash-command workflow (/analysis-codebase-archaeology:archaeology).

plugins.name: design-principles
plugins.description: Curated reference library of canonical design principles (Dieter Rams, Joshua Porter, Bruce Tognazzini, inclusive design, Postel's law, principle of least surprise) for UI, product, and crosscutting design judgment.

plugins.name: terraform-audit
plugins.description: Brutal, structured audit of a Terraform or OpenTofu module repository. Detects cross-module composition smells (overlap, duplication, thin wrappers, scope-discriminator primitives, copy-pasted module blocks, tier misplacement), cross-project / cross-account linking flaws, missing validations, dead code, version-pinning drift, and provider-specific landing-zone gaps (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI). Produces an 8-section critique with per-module grades and a concrete defect list, with optional baseline diff. Workflow at /terraform-audit:audit [path]. Bundles Anton Babenko's terraform-skill v1.6.0 (Apache-2.0) for canonical Terraform best-practices context.
plugins.license: MIT (with bundled Apache-2.0 terraform-skill by Anton Babenko at skills/terraform-skill/)

plugins.name: anvil
plugins.description: Atomic design + Storybook 10 expert toolkit. CSF Factories only (no exceptions). TanStack-ecosystem-centric. Web (Tailwind 4) + native (NativeWind / Expo / Reanimated). Ships `@anvil/inspector` — a structurally precise TS toolkit (TypeScript Compiler API + ast-grep) with 24 CLI verbs: per-component cards (props/stories/variants/consumers/tokens/issues), full design-system inventory via the structural import graph, body-tree archaeology pipeline (NDJSON-piping verbs + 10 project-extensible JSON presets for raw HTML containers, hardcoded spacing/colour, inline styles, untokenised classes, image-no-alt, link-no-href, button-no-label, data-attr-without-testid), and structural mutations (rename-component / rename-prop / rename-story-title / rename-jsx-prop / remove-import / safe-delete / verify-mdx / orphan-exports — all dry-run by default). The `safe-code-mutation` skill encodes the no-regex-on-.ts/.tsx rule that the inspector embodies. 19 slash-command workflows including 10 inspector commands plus the existing audit/add/merge suite. Inter-agent HANDOFF.md contract. Tier-1 baseline diff + Tier-2 dated audit history.
plugins.license: MIT (with Apache-2.0 portions adapted from TheBushidoCollective/han for the 7 atomic-design methodology references)

plugins.name: rust-monorepo-orchestrator
plugins.description: Methodology-first multi-agent refactoring orchestrator for monorepos. Context-aware: scripts/discover-workspace.sh walks up from cwd to find the workspace and detects services + aggregates automatically; commands take zero path arguments by default. Service-level by default: /audit-domain <service> drills ALL aggregates in parallel; /plan-refactor <service> produces ONE unified PLAN.md with cross-aggregate depends_on and de-duplicated shared-infrastructure tickets; /run-wave-ralph <service> drives a single inbox. New /migrate command runs /init -> /audit -> /plan -> decisions gate -> /run end-to-end with reasoning gates at each phase. Spawns parallel waves of Opus-orchestrated, Sonnet-implemented subagents that drill a domain top-to-bottom (HTTP -> events -> views -> inter-service events), document violations, author ast-grep rules, then run isolated-worktree workers with claim-lock concurrency, automerge on verifier-pass, dead-letter on failure. Two wave runners: /run-wave (subagent-driven) and /run-wave-ralph (bash Ralph loop, no nested-Agent dispatch, disk-resumable, live monitor). Ralph mode side-loads five per-session hooks via --settings: SessionStart workspace-tree injection (no exploration turns), PreToolUse allowed_paths enforcement, Stop auto-commit (conventional-commits), shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR (5-10x Rust compile), and a verifier:deterministic bash verifier route. Nine slash commands, nine subagents, three methodology skills.

plugins.name: carbon-solana
plugins.description: Carbon Solana indexing framework reference. Auto-loaded knowledge for the carbon-core pipeline (datasources, pipes, processors, decoders, schema matching) and per-protocol sub-skills for 64 Solana programs (Raydium AMM v4 / CLMM / CPMM / Launchpad, Pumpfun, Pump Swap, Meteora DLMM / DAMM v2 / DBC / Pools / Vault, Orca Whirlpool, Phoenix v1, OpenBook v2, Jupiter Swap / DCA / Limit / Perpetuals / Lend, Drift v2, Zeta, Marginfi v2, Kamino lending / vault / farms / limit-order, Lifinity, Stabble, Sharky, Marinade, Solayer, Bubblegum, MPL Core / Token Metadata, SPL Token / Token-2022 / ATA, ALT, Stake, System, Memo, Name Service, Swig, Wavebreak, Gavel, OKX DEX, DFlow, Circle CCTP v2, and more). Bundled scripts/carbon.py extracts struct fields, discriminators, and account variants on demand from your local cargo registry cache (or $CARBON_SRC) -- no stale snapshots.

plugins.name: harness-tuner
plugins.description: Meta-plugin: optimize the Claude Code harness for a project. Reads session transcripts to digest recurring user friction, audits CLAUDE.md / skills / rules / commands / hooks / monitors across the hierarchy, and recommends additions / edits / removals -- never touching the root CLAUDE.md. Hierarchy-aware (parent-but-not-root); uses @ imports for cwd-relative content; for monorepos, can author a per-service summary CLAUDE.md that autoloads when working in that subtree. Four-phase pipeline: /digest -> /audit -> /plan -> /tune. Hard rules: never edits root CLAUDE.md, never edits ~/.claude/, refuses CLAUDE.md changes that exceed 200 lines or path-scoped rule changes that exceed 150 lines, validates @ imports resolve, appends one line to .claude/CHANGELOG.md per applied change.

plugins.name: meta-skill-improver
plugins.description: Evidence-grounded skill evolution. Mines transcripts and git history across one or many repos for recurring user friction on a topic, clusters the friction into anonymized failure-mode reproducers, synthesizes a four-class prompt matrix per failure mode, runs a sandbox harness with and without the candidate skill loaded, and produces a mathematically-graded scorecard with a promote-or-block verdict. Treats the skill-under-test as a non-deterministic SUT and uses property-based-testing-with-N-runs methodology to separate signal from noise. Builds on the /codify pipeline (transcript-analyzer, skill-author, skill-auditor) and adds the missing executor-and-grader stages.

plugins.name: k8s-deployment-readiness
plugins.description: Three-gate Kubernetes deployment readiness workflow (develop / staging|uat / production) derived from learnkube.com/production-best-practices. Verifies application code, Kubernetes manifests (Helm/Kustomize/raw YAML), Terraform/OpenTofu modules, and GitOps configs (Argo CD/Flux) against a tiered checklist that grows per gate. Bundles deep OpenTelemetry guidance: semantic conventions, histogram bucket selection, exemplars wired SDK->Collector->Prometheus, head vs tail sampling with trace affinity, and Google-SRE-Table-5-8 multi-burn-rate SLO alerting with worked examples. Two specialized read-only subagents (deployment-verifier, observability-auditor) load six internal skills that are not user-invocable.

plugins.name: oracle
plugins.description: Truth-verification harness with structured research, budget-aware rate-limit gating, multi-workspace MCP onboarding, transcript-corpus-derived behavioural guards, and (new in 0.6.0) a CodeRabbit-style session-summary checkpoint loop. Verification: SessionStart hook injects a protocol; PreToolUse hook on Bash intercepts unpinned installs across 13 package managers; tiered PreToolUse + PostToolUse gating on the bundled firecrawl-mcp@3.2.1 surface (silent under 80% used, soft remind 80-95%, ask 95-100% or single-call >=15% or rolling-hour over 5000 cr, deny over 100%). Seven slash commands: /oracle:setup, /oracle:verify, /oracle:research [--intensity], /oracle:vet, /oracle:budget, /oracle:mcp-fleet, /oracle:narrator. Five Opus-4.7 subagents. Seven auto-trigger knowledge skills. Session-summary checkpoint loop (UserPromptSubmit + Stop + SessionEnd): cumulative agent-active milliseconds accrue on Stop only so user-AFK time is structurally excluded; UserPromptSubmit fires a CodeRabbit-style review every 30 minutes of active work or every 50 turns (whichever lands first), with deterministic tool-call counts plus an LLM narrative + three self-review questions generated by the narrator model selected via /oracle:narrator (defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6; aliases sonnet/opus/haiku; `off` disables the LLM tier). safe-edit-guard PreToolUse hook on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit reminds when target path has not been Read within a 30-minute freshness window; track-reads PostToolUse hook records read state per session. Targets ~1,128 read-before-edit errors plus ~300 speculative-path failures plus 676 long-session interrupts observed across the local 1,186-transcript corpus. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
